_extract.note: Complete reverse-audit extract for the Make six-pack suite. It admits every official method/path route except the one binary request body that the current REST binding cannot represent without corruption.
_extract.unpaged_collection_note: These array-shaped GET responses expose no pg[limit]/pg[offset] pair or other continuation contract in the pinned official fragments. They remain callable one-dispatch operations and are deliberately not marked single_page, so the runtime never certifies completeness without documentary proof.

transport_notes.jsonc: Routes offering both application/json and application/jsonc select the JSON representation.
transport_notes.multipart: AI context creation selects the official application/json alternative; the same method/path remains admitted without pretending the REST binding can upload multipart files.
transport_notes.event_stream: The finite AI-agent run stream is callable, but connection.api buffers text/event-stream until the response closes instead of exposing incremental events.
transport_notes.binary_download: The SDK app icon GET uses response_capture and returns a file_ref.
transport_notes.raw_text: Markdown and JavaScript request bodies use body_raw with their official Content-Type.

exclusions.reason: The official route requires an image/png request body. connection.api only accepts UTF-8 string body_raw or JSON/form fields; using it for arbitrary PNG bytes would corrupt the request. The route stays excluded until the REST binding supports file_ref request bodies.
